text: Test 1 gives a bounded result. PSR J0740 plus 6620 measures 2.08 plus or minus 0.07 times the sun's mass. It clears 2.00 at 68.3%, but not at the stricter 95.4% level. So the heavy star test reaches serious doubt, not strict falsification. Still, three qualifying systems exceed the literal 1.5 ceiling by at least eight standard deviations each. That ceiling is contradicted.
